name: Claude Code v2.1.328–2.1.329
hook: Two back-to-back releases landed November 19. v2.1.328 brings Auto mode to Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, and the Claude apps gateway — plus `"onFailure": "block"` for `mcp_tool` hooks and a tighter `/code-review` (bugs and CLAUDE.md violations only; use `/simplify` for cleanup). v2.1.329 adds `/tasks` showing all scheduled tasks and `/loop` wakeups with one-key stop, OpenTelemetry while Code Mode is on, and a trust dialog showing exactly where a folder's hooks are declared.

name: Superpowers
hook: Complete software-development methodology for coding agents, built by Jesse Vincent and Prime Radiant. 322k stars. A composable set of skills covering the full dev lifecycle — planning, implementation, review, and ship. Available directly from the official Anthropic plugin marketplace; also supports Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. MIT-licensed.

name: lemo-opuscar
hook: 99 cinematic and illustrative film-style recipes for Claude Code — from watercolor and woodblock ukiyo-e to Bauhaus, 8-bit, newsreel, and whiteboard. Each style ships with a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5, no video model used. Supports custom styles. 19k stars. MIT (code), CC BY-NC 4.0 (docs/prompts).
install: claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar && claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab

name: Andrej Karpathy Skills
hook: Single CLAUDE.md encoding four Karpathy-inspired coding guardrails: Think First (plan before coding), Simplicity (simplest solution that works), Surgical Changes (minimal footprint), Goal-Driven (resist scope creep). Community project, not an official Karpathy release. 132K–205K stars across mirrors — the most-starred single-file skill in the ecosystem.
install: npx skills add multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills --skill karpathy-guidelines --agent claude-code

name: claude-mem
recurring_note: ↑ Day 11 — record GitHub weekly trending streak in the Claude ecosystem; 83.9k stars and 288+ releases
hook: Persistent memory layer for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, and more. Now at 11 consecutive days on GitHub weekly trending — the longest streak of any Claude ecosystem repo. 83.9k stars, 288+ releases.

name: agent-skills (Addy Osmani)
recurring_note: ↑ Day 7 — 117.5k+ stars; broad cross-agent adoption continues
hook: Google Chrome DevTools lead Addy Osmani's 25 lifecycle skills for senior-engineering workflows — define → plan → build → verify → review → ship. Day 7 on trending. Ships specialist personas: code-reviewer, test-engineer, security-auditor, web-performance-auditor. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Kiro.

name: Coucou
hook: Tiny macOS notch app that monitors Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI — surfaces agent permission requests in the notch and lets you approve them from your iPhone lock screen. 7.4k stars. Also supports Windows 10/11, Linux (AppImage/.deb/.rpm/NixOS), and Android 11+. MIT (code), by Louis Raillé.
install: brew tap louis-cfm/coucou https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou && brew install --cask coucou

name: Earshot
hook: MCP server and CLI that gives coding agents ears and a voice: describes what a sound file contains in words, matches audio to text descriptions, locates moments in long recordings, checks whether audio is real or synthesized, reviews films with a listening transcript, and generates sounds from code recipes. Ships 252 built-in SFX. CPU-only (~1.1 GB model download), MIT, 5.3k stars.
install: uv tool install "earshot[mcp] @ git+https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot" && earshot doctor --fetch

name: Floorplan
hook: Claude or Codex reads your codebase and draws an interactive, plain-English map of it — no config, no embeddings, no vector store. Output is a navigable HTML file showing files, functions, and their relationships. 5.5k stars, MIT, by Hayden Smith. Node 18+ required; also works with Codex.
install: claude plugin marketplace add haydenschmitty/floorplan && claude plugin install floorplan@floorplan

name: Agentic Awesome Skills (AAS Core)
recurring_note: ↑ Day 8 — 49.8k stars; v20.8.0 added Data Analytics and DevOps & Cloud bundles this week
hook: 49.8k stars, v20.8.0, 2,957+ SKILL.md playbooks across 13 specialized plugins. v20.8.0 this week adds Data Analytics and DevOps & Cloud bundles. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, and Kiro.
install: gh skill install sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills skills/<name>/SKILL.md --agent claude-code

name: Huashu Art Motion
hook: 36 art-style recipes — cave painting, Van Gogh, Bauhaus, Kubrick, 8-bit, Rick & Morty and more — plus 9 explainer-video grammars (Kurzgesagt, Vox, whiteboard, presenter). Renders frame-accurate clips from JSON specs via Playwright + ffmpeg. 7k stars. By the creator of huashu-design (29.5k stars).

name: Drama Skills (zenstory-ai)
hook: AI short-drama and motion-comics workflow end to end: IP evaluation, script adaptation from novels, storyboard generation, character and scene design, and automated video review against brief. Pairs with huashu-art-motion for the visual layer. 4.3k stars. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and OpenCode.

name: Oh Story (Chinese Web Novel Skills)
recurring_note: ↑ Day 7 — 8.6k stars; added cover-generation and anti-AI-prose modules earlier this week
hook: Full-workflow skill pack for writing Chinese web novels: topic scouting from ranking sites, hit-novel deconstruction, long-form foreshadowing tracking, twist-short-story writing, anti-AI-prose stripping, and cover generation. Sister project to drama-skills from the same team. 8.6k stars.
